topic: Fresh-main containment of public brain-corpus export and autonomous repository writers

observations.claim: The observed main ref resolved to 9283d6741754ced75da3ce8e6199db246c0c7fa9. That commit is a Cross-analysis refresh modifying only ping-pongings/knowledge-base/sentiment_shift.json and has parent c10df2896572a7df7daebfa4f43899f76c31b100.

Main dump-brain-corpus.yml is manually dispatchable, grants contents:write, injects DATABRICKS_TOKEN into scripts/dump_brain_corpus.py, stages brain_corpus/, commits and pushes the corpus to public main.

The exporter queries workspace.barrot.brain for timestamp, topic, insight and session, then writes brain_corpus/dump.json and dump.md. No Databricks secret value was accessed and no query was run during this audit.

The current public brain_corpus directory contains dump.json (353950 bytes), dump.md (296527 bytes), 12 polymath_*.json files and topics.txt (25154 bytes). The 13 non-dump files remain unclassified; their contents were not inspected and are not removed by this proposal.
Main merge-queue.yml is manually dispatchable with mode=all, max_prs=0 meaning unlimited, dry_run=false by default, contents:write and pull-requests:write, and code that can invoke gh pr merge.
Main scheduler-tick.yml runs every 15 minutes with contents:write and actions:write, executes scripts/scheduler.py tick and commits queue updates to main.
Main scripts/scheduler.py accepts any existing workflow filename rather than an explicit allowlist; a queue entry can therefore target any workflow present in .github/workflows.
Main cross-analysis.yml grants contents:write and commits/pushes generated entity co-occurrence and sentiment artifacts. The current main head itself is a Cross-analysis refresh commit.
Main task-allocator.yml references Groq, OpenAI and ChatGPT tokens and has contents:write and pull-requests:write permissions. A verified nine-platform adapter/permission map is not established.

Main Kaggle workflow runs on a daily schedule and references kaggle_competitions_automation.py at repository root, which returns 404; the implementation exists under scripts/. No submission was made by this audit.

Main subscriber_sync.yml reads Gumroad sale email fields, hashes them with unsalted SHA-256, and commits the resulting list to public web/subscribers.json. The current public file is exactly {"emails": [], "count": 0}; no subscriber identifiers are present in the current file. The workflow remains a separate privacy risk.

proposed_changes: Disable public brain-corpus export with empty workflow permissions and an inert job.
Remove only brain_corpus/dump.json and brain_corpus/dump.md from the proposed current tree; retain the other 13 directory entries pending classification.
Disable broad merge queue and its branch/merge mutation path.
Disable the 15-minute Scheduler Tick pending a durable non-main state store and per-action authorization.
Make Cross Analysis read-only and retain outputs as bounded workflow artifacts.
Disable unverified multi-provider task allocator and scheduled Kaggle submission workflow.
Restrict scheduler.py to a fixed allowlist of input-free read-only validation workflows.
Add focused regression tests and parse all six changed workflows as YAML in CI.
limitations: No local worktree was available through the GitHub connector; dirty local files and local branches were not inspected.
No Databricks, Gumroad, Hugging Face, Kaggle or model-provider credentials were read or used.
The 13 non-dump brain_corpus entries were not inspected or classified.
Removing files from the current tree does not erase historical Git objects, forks, caches or external copies.
This proposal does not contain subscriber_sync.yml, Daily Digest, Auto-Resolve or other PR #1573 paths; those remain separately active on main.
No merge, force-push, privileged workflow dispatch, deployment, paper trade or real-money action occurred.
